title: Why Crying Gives You a Stuffy Nose
caption:
Your tears secretly drain straight into your nose.
A teary cartoon guy gets a full diagnosis: his tears flow through a built-in overflow pipe, ending with him on the couch in nose plugs and a snorkel.
Tears drain from your eyes through the nasolacrimal duct into your nose; when you cry, the excess overflows and makes your nose stuffy.
Does your nose get stuffy every time you cry too?
